newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says rebel Kurds killed by own mines.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says rebel Kurds killed by own mines.

text.p: Turkey said on Tuesday that four Kurdish guerrillas had died after stepping on land mines they planted themselves in a mountainous area near the border with Iraq.
The state-run Anatolian news agency said the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels had sown the mines in Hakkari province, intending to draw security forces into the area.
It was not clear when the deaths took place or why the rebels stepped on the mines. Independent confirmation of the report was impossible.
More than 24,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between the security forces and the PKK, fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
Thousands of Turkish troops are fighting the PKK in northern Iraq where the rebels have bases.
